name: coactivator associated arginine methyltransferase 1
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase I

function.text: CARM1 encodes histone-arginine methyltransferase CARM1. Annotated molecular activities include histone methyltransferase activity and protein methyltransferase activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase I.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
